title: Tom Is Sick
text:
Tom is sick today. He has a headache and a cough. He stays in bed. His mother gives him soup.

On Monday, Tom goes to the doctor. The doctor is kind. She gives him medicine. After three days, Tom feels better.

questions.text: What does the doctor give Tom?
How does Tom probably feel at the beginning of the story?
Why does Tom's mother give him soup?
options: Because he wants to play football
Because it may help him feel better

vocabulary.definition: a substance you take to help you get better when you are ill
a person who works to help sick people

paragraph_translations: Tom está doente hoje. Ele tem dor de cabeça e tosse. Ele fica na cama. A mãe dele lhe dá sopa.
Na segunda-feira, Tom vai ao médico. A médica é gentil. Ela lhe dá remédio. Depois de três dias, Tom se sente melhor.
